name: Survey & Task
author: István Koren
description: Runs a study inside the workspace: a questionnaire panel that opens the visualisation each question is about, beside itself, with the parameters the author captured — and reads back what the participant did to it. A question can therefore be a task rather than a description of one, and its answer can be an element selected in a diagram or the state a filter was left in, not only a typed sentence. Nine question kinds, counterbalanced A/B blocks so a comparison is not also measuring which condition came first, and a response recorded with the stimulus and its parameters as submitted, so any answer can be put back on screen exactly as it was given. Surveys and responses are ordinary artifacts — a response is a provenance child of the questionnaire and of the log it was run against — and JSON export/import carries them between machines, which is what a study on more than one participant needs.
